DIRECTION CONCEPT SEED (key: oracle-key-1; mode: persuade; source: local; catalog: phoenix-2026-01; approved pool: d79644e7d5df; 24/24 catalog-curated; rerun with --scope direction --mode persuade --from oracle-key-1 --reroll 2 --register bolder --candidate-count 7 to reproduce this roll against this catalog revision)
RE-ROLL ROUND 2 (BOLDER REGISTER, user-requested): every candidate presented in earlier rounds, grounded
  and challenger alike, is eliminated and may not return reworded.
BOLDER REGISTER: the user asked for foreign forms at full commitment, so no
  grounded direction is presented this round and the assigned index is
  suspended. The hand is every dealt challenger below, each fused with the
  product and presented as a full card; the FIRST dealt challenger leads, an
  assignment by deal order, so the dice still choose. Verdicts and donations
  apply between the challengers, weighed against the leader. The pick card
  sits out; the canon stays, as always.
CHALLENGERS:
  1. A progressive offer fit check, explicit requirements reveal a suitable option and the assumptions behind it in a short editable sequence.
     SOURCE ID: phoenix-persuade-fit-check
     CREATIVE SPARK: Make a recommendation inspectable: changing one requirement reveals the precise reason the option changes, with no fabricated savings or compulsory contact form.
     SYSTEM GRAMMAR:
       - Palette/material: Use a neutral question field and deep teal selected states; keep unselected choices readable.
       - Type/composition: Give each question one clear sentence; place a concise explanation beside the resulting recommendation.
       - Topology/navigation: Retain answers in an editable summary; connect the proposed plan to the requirements that caused it.
       - Controls/state: Allow back, meaningful skip, and clear actions; disclose unknown fit instead of inventing certainty.
       - Responsive/motion: Use one mobile column; preserve focus on step changes and remove transition motion on request.
     WEB LEVERAGE: Use grouped radio inputs, explicit step headings, and a result summary exposing how answers map to an offer.
     MEDIA: text-only candidate; no local image supplied
  2. An inspectable procurement claim chain, each claim opens its actual supporting document, scope, date, and limitation in place.
     SOURCE ID: phoenix-persuade-trust-chain
     CREATIVE SPARK: A credible claim survives being opened: readers can inspect which part is supported, when the evidence was issued, and what remains outside its scope without interpreting a decorative seal.
     SYSTEM GRAMMAR:
       - Palette/material: Use restrained graphite and white; differentiate evidence types by text labels rather than badge color.
       - Type/composition: Follow each short claim heading with its qualification; keep document dates easy to scan.
       - Topology/navigation: Group evidence beneath its claim; keep the purchasing path outside expanded supporting detail.
       - Controls/state: Label unavailable or outdated evidence honestly; expand detail with a named control and clear close action.
       - Responsive/motion: Stack claim and evidence on mobile; preserve reading position when details expand and avoid surprise motion.
     WEB LEVERAGE: Use details and summary for concise evidence, accessible links for actual attachments, and explicit issue-date text.
     MEDIA: text-only candidate; no local image supplied
  3. A focused event registration stage, one invitation is framed by the actual date, access conditions, and a single registration path.
     SOURCE ID: phoenix-persuade-focused-launch
     CREATIVE SPARK: Give the launch a memorable center without requiring spectacle: a strong invitation and precise attendance facts make the next step feel clear, timely, and achievable.
     SYSTEM GRAMMAR:
       - Palette/material: Use deep indigo around a high-contrast light content region; one coral accent identifies registration.
       - Type/composition: Give the event name a readable distinctive scale; align date, time zone, location, and access notes below it.
       - Topology/navigation: Hold one invitation first; follow with attendance details and then the complete registration step.
       - Controls/state: State open, full, and closed registration honestly; show countdowns only for real meaningful deadlines.
       - Responsive/motion: Let the heading wrap naturally on mobile; provide a still alternative to optional ambient movement.
     WEB LEVERAGE: Use time elements with visible time zones, explicit location information, and a clearly labeled registration form.
     MEDIA: text-only candidate; no local image supplied
  4. A measured membership welcome, a hospitable introduction is bounded by clear participation expectations and booking conditions.
     SOURCE ID: phoenix-persuade-measured-welcome
     CREATIVE SPARK: Create warmth through considerate information: someone can understand how they will be welcomed, what participation involves, and what they may need to arrange before choosing to join.
     SYSTEM GRAMMAR:
       - Palette/material: Use soft cream and muted green; render practical conditions in dark text rather than faint footnotes.
       - Type/composition: Pair a brief welcome with readable expectations; give booking information equal clarity to the invitation.
       - Topology/navigation: Move from purpose to participation rules to booking; retain cost, accessibility, and cancellation details nearby.
       - Controls/state: Name availability and booking states plainly; use real member accounts only when supplied and authorized.
       - Responsive/motion: Keep generous but bounded mobile spacing; use still surfaces without an obligatory animated introduction.
     WEB LEVERAGE: Use semantic headings, an accessible conditions list, and a booking action naming the concrete next step.
     MEDIA: text-only candidate; no local image supplied
  5. A proof-led service comparison, aligned criteria connect each promise to a bounded claim and a visible price unit.
     SOURCE ID: phoenix-persuade-proof-comparison
     CREATIVE SPARK: Make the reason to choose visible in the comparison itself: one row shows a limit, its evidence, and its cost basis without asking readers to decode promotional badges.
     SYSTEM GRAMMAR:
       - Palette/material: Use a pale mineral field and dark ink grid; reserve one accessible blue for the offered next step.
       - Type/composition: Place a concise promise above the comparison; align units and limits instead of enlarging every price.
       - Topology/navigation: Keep plan names beside the same criteria; place evidence directly after the claim it qualifies.
       - Controls/state: Label included, limited, and unavailable states in text; name each plan selection action clearly.
       - Responsive/motion: Stack labeled plan groups on narrow screens; retain criterion order and avoid animated ranking.
     WEB LEVERAGE: Use semantic table headers, tabular numerals, and linked evidence notes; preserve criterion labels in the stacked mobile presentation.
     MEDIA: text-only candidate; no local image supplied
  6. A cost-visible service offer, one total is anchored to included work, exclusions, and the timing of each payment.
     SOURCE ID: phoenix-persuade-cost-visible-offer
     CREATIVE SPARK: Let an offer feel considered through its transparent edges: customers can locate what is included, what costs extra, and when payment happens before reaching the decision button.
     SYSTEM GRAMMAR:
       - Palette/material: Use warm white and charcoal; a restrained ochre marks scope boundaries with sufficient contrast.
       - Type/composition: Give total and billing basis a shared heading; set inclusions and exclusions at the same readable size.
       - Topology/navigation: Arrange scope, cost, and payment schedule in one path; keep the next step after the complete offer.
       - Controls/state: Show selected options and recalculated totals explicitly; label an estimate when it is not binding.
       - Responsive/motion: Stack the breakdown without hiding exclusions; update values without number-counting motion.
     WEB LEVERAGE: Use a description list for scope and a labeled cost breakdown; announce recalculation without moving keyboard focus.
     MEDIA: text-only candidate; no local image supplied
Fuse each challenger before judging it: the challenger supplies the form
  and its system grammar, the product supplies every fact, and clarity wins
  conflicts. Weigh every fused challenger against the fused LEADER, the first
  dealt, on exactly two axes, audience identification and product clarity;
  verdicts and donations apply between the challengers, and one that beats
  the leader on both axes presents as the hand's strongest alternate.
Compare supplied local images only when they exist. A text-only candidate has no visual reference; do not invent a board or contact a remote image service.
PRODUCT.md and explicit incumbent brand commitments constrain every direction.
The seed never chooses exact colors, fonts, tokens, or a user preference, and
it never permits the world and first surface to be selected independently.
The CREATIVE SPARK is a complete visual system, not a theme or decorative
reference. Translate every supplied system rule into the product: palette and
material, type and composition, topology, controls and states, and adaptation.
Keep the source's visible character, scale, rhythm, and interaction instead of
reducing vivid grammar to generic nouns. Keep a literal carrier only when it
becomes functional.
Ambitious motion, spatial media, or interaction is welcome when it strengthens
the product without weakening semantics, performance, or fallback behavior.
